Our literature review on CARS in assistive technology investigates current research and developments in this field, focusing on foundational theories, algorithms, applications, and limitations. It aims to uncover how these technologies can be harnessed to improve communication for individuals with limited speech capabilities. Ultimately, this review emphasizes the transformative role of CARS in assistive technology, providing new avenues for more effective and autonomous communication for those with speech disabilities.

articleTitle: Path Finding Camera Network Using Edge Device
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: Object tracking through camera surveillance can be used as a tool for reducing criminal activities and increasing the security especially in modern city life. A prototype for a multi-camera surveillance system that can identify objects and track their movements across multiple cameras is proposed. The system was built on a platform that included a Raspberry Pi, an Edge TPU, and three cameras and has been able to accurately detect objects in a variety of conditions and scenarios. Real time comparison of two object detection algorithms, ‘you only look once’ (YOLO) and omni-scale network (OSNet) is carried out. Re-identification of the object was demonstrated with the optimal use of available memory of the system. The proposed system demonstrated high performance in terms of throughput, latency, and model accuracy, making it a viable solution for real-time multi- object tracking and re-identification without utilizing a cloud server.

articleTitle: Dynamic Task and Resource allocation optimization for decentralized Swarm UAVs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: This paper uses an algorithm for swarm UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) task and resource assignment, integrating with the A* algorithm, which relies on a task chain technique. When a task chain is defined, UAVs allocate time to necessary tasks and synchronize their schedules. Simulation experiments validate the effectiveness of the algorithm in ensuring proper and efficient task allocation to UAVs.

articleTitle: Integrating Facial Expression Recognition for Emotion Responsive Music Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: Music has a profound impact on human emotions, enriching experiences and serving as a powerful means of expression. In contemporary times, the synergy between music and machine learning has revolutionized the way we engage with and explore musical experiences. This research delves into the intricate relationship between emotions and music, leveraging machine learning algorithms, culminating in an innovative emotion-based music recommendation system. This system employs facial emotion recognition (FER) as a key mechanism, harnessing the expressive canvas of the human face to decipher emotions accurately. The system integrates YOLOv4 for facial detection and the Humingbird library for emotion analysis. Leveraging a dataset comprising 278,000 Spotify songs labeled by emotion, the system recommends a Spotify song URL aligned with the user’s detected emotion. We also created a simple yet efficient interface for user interaction utilising streamlit web application tools. This system not only underscores the intricacies of emotional connections with music but also underscores the transformative potential of combining human expression with cutting-edge technology.

articleTitle: AIDoList - AI Powered Task Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: The AIDoList system is an innovative endeavor aimed at revolutionizing the way individuals manage their daily tasks and commitments. This system seeks to develop a state of the-art task organization and management application empowered by artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities. AIDoList is designed to enhance task management efficiency, user experience, providing a comprehensive solution for users’ productivity needs. It’s main strength surrounds the fact that it can accept input from a user in natural language with spelling mistakes and then corrects them into proper format. Key system objectives include natural language processing (NLP) for multiple task input, task categorization, voice and speech recognition for hands-free task creation, reminding tasks with deadline, intelligent task suggestions, providing user insights. The system also prioritizes user-friendliness with an intuitive and visually appealing interface. It suggests tasks that are most frequently done by the user. AI gets lists of completed and failed tasks and gives advice to the user. This system represents a significant step forward in leveraging AI to streamline daily life and empower users to make the most of their time.

articleTitle: EcoBalance Rewards: Coin Disbursement Based on Plastic Mass Equivalence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: Recycling is one of the new methods for efficient waste management. The way recycling is now done, which requires people to deliver vast amounts of rubbish to recycling centers, can be annoying and demotivating. The reverse vending machine (RVM) concept served as the inspiration for the featured bonus. The Reverse vending machines are economical, save time and energy, and lessen the workload for staff members. The goal of the work is to introduce the idea of a reverse vending machine and the cash-from-trash idea. Here, recycled plastic can be utilized to make useful products while also lowering pollution and greenhouse gas emissions. In the proposed work, the reverse vending machine is activated upon the insertion of a plastic material. Coins are the incentive given to users of reverse vending machines. Depending on the weight of the plastic products, the reverse vending machine manages their acceptance and awards coins. This sample machine is outlined, constructed and evaluated. It performed well, achieving both efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of 2D and 3D Convolutional Neural Networks for Melanoma Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: Skin Melanoma is a lethal type of cancer. The early diagnosis of which is crucial to improve the survival rate of the patients. Convolution neural networks are at the heart of the deep learning algorithms. In the present work authors have experimentally compared 2D and 3D Convolution Neural Network (CNN) models to identify the melanoma. We have employed three different types of datasets namely PH2, ISIC archive, and ISIC skin cancer datasets. We applied the two models on each of the datasets to determine their accuracy, precision, recall, f1 score and ROC curves. The experimental results provide the insights about the advantages and limitations of using 2D and 3D CNN models for the identification of skin melanoma. The authors have observed that 2D CNN model shows enhanced capabilities to detect skin lesion structures compared to 3D CNN. Moreover, the classification accuracy of the 2D CNN is also found better than 3D CNN.

articleTitle: Non-Invasive Oral Cancer Detection Using Hyperspectral Imaging and Advanced Spectral Unmixing Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: Oral cancer is a significant global health concern, often leading to high mortality rates due to late-stage diagnosis and the lack of effective early detection methods. Despite advances in medical science, the absence of reliable early diagnostic tools remains a critical challenge. Hyperspectral imaging (HSI) has emerged as a powerful noninvasive technology, capturing detailed spectral information across a wide range of wavelengths. This allows for accurate differentiation between cancerous and healthy tissues, improving early detection and enhancing treatment outcomes. In this study, we propose the use of HSI for early oral cancer diagnosis. To address the scarcity of labeled data, we developed a synthetic hyperspectral dataset that includes spectral signatures of both normal and cancerous tissues. The dataset was generated using a bilinear mixing model, with key spectral features extracted through Vertex Component Analysis (VCA) and abundances computed using Non-Negative Least Squares (NNLS). The model's performance was evaluated using Spectral angle distance (SAD) and Root mean square error (RMSE) metrics. Our findings demonstrate that HSI significantly improves the accuracy of early oral cancer detection, outperforming traditional methods. This work highlights the potential of advanced imaging technologies in revolutionizing cancer diagnosis, offering a robust framework for non-invasive detection and showcasing the effectiveness of synthetic datasets in medical imaging research.

articleTitle: A Hybrid LLM based Model for Calorie Tracker and Dietary Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: The importance of attainable and efficient dietary management options is clearly visible through the increasing occurrences of obesity and associated health conditions. While traditional techniques of calorie tracking are useful, they can be labor-intensive and highly prone to errors, highlighting the requirement for novel technology alternatives. This work presents the use of advanced natural language processing to intensify user experience and accuracy in dietary control for a Large Language Model (LLM)-based calorie tracker. To get a more natural approach for measuring calorie intake, creating customized dietary goals, and receiving real-time feedback we use AI and machine learning algorithms in the program (GPT-3 and GPT-4). To control intermittent fasting habits, measure hydration, and monitor weight variations, various tools are provided by the device. Deep learning techniques such as Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) are implemented to give support and personalized recommendations to help users overcome hindrances and achieve their health goals, thus contributing to overall health and well-being.

articleTitle: A Multi-Modal Transformer Optimized Object Identification Model for Passenger Safety in Ridesharing Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: The rapid growth of the ride-sharing industry has brought many benefits but also introduced significant safety challenges. To address this, we developed TransformerYOLO, a new AI system that enhances passenger safety by combining two powerful technologies: YOLO, known for its speed in detecting objects, and transformers, recognized for their ability to understand complex interactions. Our goal is to create a system that not only quickly spots potential threats but also understands what’s happening inside a vehicle. Traditional object detection models often struggle in cars due to factors like changing light and limited space. Our design prioritizes privacy by focusing on detecting objects and actions rather than identifying individuals. The system also includes a real-time alert mechanism to immediately detect and respond to threats. Through this research, we aim to set a new standard for safety in the ride-sharing sector, improving user trust and industry practices. TransformerYOLO’s ability to assess and understand the in-vehicle environment enhances the safety experience for both passengers and drivers. Our system’s adaptability and privacy-conscious design make it a promising solution for widespread use, paving the way for safer and more reliable urban transportation.

articleTitle: X-ray Image Analysis for Aided Detection of COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: The COVID-19 epiphytotic highlighted the necessity for speedy and accessible identification instruments. Chest X-rays offer a readily available and relatively inexpensive Tomography proficiency. This stuff explores the potential of X-ray image analysis using Profound learning algorithmic program for the aided detection of COVID-19 contagions. While chest X-rays and CT scans are valuable instruments for COVID-19 diagnosis, manual analysis is time-consuming and error-prone. Profound learning, a powerful subset of artificial intelligence[10], offers promising solutions for automated and accurate COVID-19 detection from these Tomography modalities. This stuff reviews key investigation findings on Profound learning-based classification of COVID-19 using chest X-rays and CT scans. We explore the current state-of-the-art advancements, discuss remaining challenges, and outline potential future directions in this crucial field. Containing COVID-19 relies heavily on isolating infected individuals and widespread inoculation. While RT-PCR tests remain the gold standard for diagnosis, delays in processing limit their effectiveness. Additionally, post-recovery positive tests raise concerns about accuracy [7]. Vaccines offer protection, but breakthrough contagions occur. Developing highly effective, long-lasting vaccines and achieving planetary immunization face significant logistical hurdles. Faster and more reliable identification instruments are crucial to complement these ongoing efforts.

articleTitle: Enhanced Dynamic S-Box Design Based on Adaptive Heuristic Evolution and Multi-Stage Nonlinearity for Securing IoT-Based Remote Health Monitoring Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: This paper presents an enhanced method for designing dynamic S-Boxes, integrating adaptive heuristic evolution with multi-stage nonlinearity enhancements, tailored to improve cryptographic security in IoT-based remote health monitoring systems. The unprecedented rise in patient numbers during the COVID-19 pandemic highlighted the need for continuous health monitoring, enabled by IoT devices. Given the sensitivity and volume of health data transmitted, ensuring robust data security has become essential. The proposed S-Box design introduces an adaptive mechanism that adjusts the permutation and substitution processes based on real-time cryptographic performance feedback, optimizing the S-Box structure dynamically. By incorporating multi-stage nonlinearity, the method increases cryptographic complexity, effectively countering linear and differential cryptanalysis. The hybrid approach combines modular operations, affine transformations, and enhanced multiplicative inversion, generating a broad spectrum of robust, key-dependent S-Boxes. The method is further enhanced by introducing lightweight block encryption to secure sensitive health data in resource-constrained IoT environments. This approach also extends cryptographic evaluations to include dynamic avalanche criteria and an enhanced bit independence metric, ensuring superior resilience against attacks. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the K-star classification method in predicting critical health conditions, achieving an accuracy of 95%, with lightweight encryption providing secure data transmission. Comparative studies validate the method’s superior performance over contemporary S-Box designs, emphasizing its potential for integration in high-security cryptographic frameworks, particularly for secure communication channels and image encryption in healthcare IoT systems.

articleTitle: Cutting-Edge Scientific Innovations: Bridging Interdisciplinary Research and Technological Advancements
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: Modern science relies heavily on interdisciplinary research, which brings together specialists from many domains to address complicated, multi-faceted problems. In order to find novel and creative solutions, researchers build a better grasp of their topic by combining ideas and methods from several fields. Scientific research is improved and progress is accelerated by this comprehensive approach, which draws on the capabilities of various disciplines. Through the use of a wide range of techniques and technological instruments, interdisciplinary research not only propels groundbreaking advances but also guarantees stronger and more adaptable responses to the ever-changing demands of modern science.

articleTitle: Tumor Spread Estimation in lungs using Medical Image Segmentation based on Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: The accurate segmentation of lung tumors from medical images is pivotal for precise diagnosis and treatment planning in oncology. This study proposes a novel approach for tumor spread estimation in lungs leveraging deep neural networks (DNNs) for medical image segmentation. The proposed method employs a multi-stage framework integrating convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for automatic segmentation of lung tumors from computed tomography (CT) scans. By incorporating both spatial and contextual information, our DNN architecture enhances the segmentation accuracy, overcoming challenges such as irregular tumor shapes and low contrast boundaries. Furthermore, we introduce a quantitative assessment mechanism for estimating tumor spread, enabling clinicians to delineate tumor boundaries and predict potential metastatic regions more effectively. This methodology demonstrates promise for precise tumor detection and localization in lung CT scans, critical for early diagnosis and treatment planning in lung cancer patients. The results highlight the potential of integrating deep learning techniques with advanced medical imaging tools to enhance accuracy and efficiency in tumor spread estimation for lung cancer diagnosis.

articleTitle: Efficient Resource Utilization for Web Applications in Mobile Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: Embracement of cloud computing has been systematically rising; many businesses are migrating to the cloud in order to exploit its flexible, strong, and cost-effective nature. MCC which is on a new computing paradigm, provides many benefits to mobile users. Since, the mobile devices are dependent on the wireless communication that might give rise to the complications like lack of enough bandwidth and network congestion. In conclusion, MCC web applications’ primary goal is enhanced performance by fulfilling customer demands on time to improve the service satisfaction level of its customers. this examination of the creative method of caching data in such applications by Redis, an in-memory data repository, is aimed at the improvement of the Quality of Service. We implement two methods of obtaining application data; either by directly querying the database, or the cache. Our research shows that our testing of the caching technique outperforms in a variety of performance metrics like response time, throughput, latency, and number of hits by up to four times faster data retrieval. This upgrade is targeted at mobile devices particularly due to their limited network bandwidth and wireless connection.

articleTitle: Age Prediction Using Quantum Fourier Transform and Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: This paper presents the utilization of quantum computing in conjunction with deep learning, which constitutes a novel approach to surmounting the constraints of conventional methods in age prediction. This proposed method aspires to substantially enhance the efficiency and reduce the computational time of age prediction models by harnessing the inherent traits of quantum computing, such as superposition and entanglement. The development of quantum feature encoding techniques facilitates the representation of classical age-related data in quantum form, enabling more effective processing and analysis. Furthermore, implementing a hybrid classical-quantum architecture supplemented by quantum-enhanced classical algorithms highlights the synergistic relationship between classical and quantum computing paradigms. A comprehensive performance assessment has been carried out against conventional deep learning techniques. This paper demonstrates the current potential of quantum fourier transform and convolutional neural network in age prediction and lays a robust foundation for future advancements in quantum-enhanced applications across various domains.

articleTitle: Unlocking Cybersecurity Horizons: Exploring Cutting-Edge Technologies, Strategies, and Trends in the Dynamic Cyber Threat Landscape
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: In the contemporary digital era, cybersecurity has become a top issue for organisations worldwide, given the escalating complexity and frequency of cyber threats. This abstract encapsulates a thorough exploration of the evolving cybersecurity landscape, focusing on advanced technologies, innovative strategies, and emerging trends crucial for bolstering defenses against cyberattacks. Recent strides in ML and AI are significantly transforming the capabilities for detection of threat and response. AI-driven algorithms empower real-time analysis of extensive datasets, enhancing the speed and accuracy of threat identification. Furthermore, AI-powered automation streamlines security operations, enabling organizations to swiftly counter evolving threats. Quantum cryptography emerges as a potent shield against quantum computing threats, ensuring unparalleled encryption and data protection through principles of quantum mechanics. The shift towards zero trust architecture signifies significant modification to network security, prioritizing stringent access controls and authentication measures to minimize the attack surface and boost overall security. Blockchain technology continues to disrupt cybersecurity, offering decentralized and tamper-resistant data storage solutions, enhancing data integrity and transparency. The increase in Internet of Things devices create new cybersecurity challenges, requiring strong authentication methods and encryption protocols. Advancements in homomorphic encryption enable secure computations on encrypted data, preserving data privacy in outsourced computations. Cybersecurity professionals play a pivotal role in navigating this dynamic landscape, requiring continuous education and collaboration to combat evolving threats effectively. This paper serves as a gateway to a comprehensive understanding of cybersecurity trends, technologies, and strategies, providing organizations with the knowledge and tools needed to protect their digital assets in an ever-evolving landscape of cybersecurity.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Approach for Healthcare Decision-Making Through Integrated Data Mining and NLP-Enhanced Drug Recommendation Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: Integrating artificial intelligence (AI) is crucial for addressing challenges in healthcare, particularly in medical data analysis and drug recommendations. This paper presents two methodologies to improve healthcare decision-making using data mining and AI-driven drug recommendation systems. The first method employs data mining, sentiment analysis with the Vader tool, and Natural Language Processing (NLP) on extensive medical datasets from Hospital Information Systems (HIS). It accurately predicts diseases and offers personalized drug recommendations based on data insights, enhancing precision with a weighted average approach. The second method highlights AI’s importance in drug recommendation systems, addressing the challenge of staying updated on the latest treatments. We developed a system using NLP and Machine Learning (ML) algorithms to predict medical conditions and recommend drugs based on reviews and their usefulness. Simple symptom input provides individuals with information on their disease and helpful drugs. These methodologies significantly advance healthcare decision-making, with sentiment analysis capturing patient experiences. Experimental results demonstrate these methods effectively enhance healthcare decision-making, improving patient outcomes and efficiency.

articleTitle: Unveiling the Spectrum: A Comprehensive Exploration of Carrot Varieties in India through Advanced Classification Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: This study introduces a new way to group carrot types into four groups: Pusa Kesar, Pusa Meghali, Pusa Yamdagni, and Pusa Rudhira. It uses an improved model that mixes a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) with another called Random Forest (RF). Classifying carrot types is very important in farming to improve growing methods and increase the harvest. The new model uses the skills of both CNN and RF. This will make it better at classifying things because it can use pictures from this big collection of 8000 diverse types to create a combined system that uses features found by CNN while grouping smarts from RF. The CNN part gets important details from carrot photos, looking at where things are. Then the RF model makes better choices by taking many tree decisions in its calculations. In the test set, this model reached 95.7% correctness in overall results. This study helps precision farming by giving a strong way to sort out different kinds of carrots. The results show that fused models may help in investigating new mixed methods for studying and sorting crops.

articleTitle: An Adaptation and Evaluation for Object Detection of Small Objects Using YOLO8
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: Detecting small objects in aerial imagery, particularly from UAVs, presents unique challenges due to the reduced size of targets, complex backgrounds, and scale variations. Despite advancements in deep learning and improvements in object detection models, capturing small objects in UAV-captured images remains difficult. Conditions such as object occlusion, varying resolutions, and densely populated environments continue to impact the precision and recall of small object detection, requiring further architectural enhancements to improve performance in these scenarios.In this research, we introduce an enhanced object detection model for small-scale objects in UAV-captured imagery, addressing the unique challenges posed by varying object scales and densely packed environments. Our model incorporates several state-of-the-art improvements to the YOLOv8 architecture. First, we introduce the Multi-Scale Dynamic Attention Mechanism (MSDAM) to optimize feature extraction across multiple scales, enhancing the detection of small objects. Next, we employ a dynamic non-monotonic loss function named Weighted-Intersection over Union (WIoU) to refine bounding box regression, improving localization accuracy, particularly for small, hard-to-detect targets. To further boost performance, Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) Layers are integrated, adaptively recalibrating feature maps to emphasize the most informative channels, thus enhancing feature representation. Additionally, Soft Non-Maximum Suppression (Soft-NMS) is applied in post-processing, reducing missed detections by preserving overlapping objects in densely populated scenes. Our experiments show significant improvements in precision, recall, and mAP, demonstrating the efficiency of the proposed methodology in accomplishing accurate and computationally efficient object detection for UAV applications.

articleTitle: Multi Layered Cloud Technologies to achieve Interoperability in AI
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: The combination of multi-cloud computing with Network Function Virtualisation (NFV) is a powerful tool for carriers to deploy their network services. Virtual network services (VNS) provide them with significant cost savings and more flexibility. Academics and practitioners have struggled to find a solution that grants these services the same availability and performance as traditional networks. This intricacy arises from a multitude of sources. One key reason is the difficulty of handling fault and performance issues with NFV and VNSs that are based on multiple clouds. Virtual environments are not well-suited to rule-based approaches, which are commonly employed in conventional physical networks. Machine learning and other forms of artificial intelligence (AI) are, thankfully, working well here. This tutorial's primary goal is to help students comprehend how artificial intelligence (AI) based solutions can improve the availability and performance of these services by assisting with fault identification and localisation. To help illustrate the points, we have included a case study that is based on our previous work in this field.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Approaches for Early Detection of Bacterial Infections in Rice Crops
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: In India, rice is a vital crop cultivated extensively across various regions. The timely detection and management of rice diseases are critical for maximizing yields and minimizing crop damage. Early detection and intervention play a crucial role in maintaining high production levels and sustaining the agricultural economy. Bacterial infections, such as Bacterial Leaf Blight, Panicle Blight, and Leaf Streak, pose a significant threat to rice productivity and global food security. Environmental factors, including strong winds, heavy rainfall, extreme temperatures, humidity, and excessive nitrogen fertilizer use, exacerbate the spread of these diseases. This study introduces a machine learning-based approach for the early detection of bacterial rice diseases using image processing and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). By detecting diseases such as Leaf Blight, Panicle Blight, and Leaf Streak in the early stages, this method improves disease management and reduces crop losses. The CNN model achieved an accuracy of 77%, demonstrating its potential for providing timely and effective solutions to protect crop yields. By recognizing early signs of bacterial infections and implementing preventive strategies, farmers can safeguard their rice crops and ensure successful harvests, contributing to food security

articleTitle: Mapp3D: Real-time 3D Mapping and Geolocation Tracking using IOT devices
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: The research focuses on the integration of GPS sensors and IoT devices to create a real-time 3D mapping and geolocation tracking system. Using ESP8266 and Arduino IoT Cloud, the system enables communication between the GPS sensor and a server with Real-Time Tracking. The user-friendly dashboard allows dynamic visualisation and interaction with the map, with each button press triggering the acquisition and storage of real-time coordinates in JSON format, updating the graphical map representation. The solution is effective as it can give an exact data on a timely basis about where things are. It also supports activities like updating the node information, including edges, finding the shortest path using the A* algorithm, and displaying 3D graphs. Using Haversine and Pythagoras theorems means that the distances are calculated between the nodes with high accuracy. This research shows how IoT can be applied in real-life scenarios and has come up with a strong system that can make 3D maps as well as track the location of these maps using a simple design.

articleTitle: Integrated Model for Underwater Image Enhancement and Coral Health Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: Underwater imaging faces obstacles like limited visibility, color alteration, and image quality deterioration due to environmental factors like turbidity and inadequate lighting. These issues have an impact on oceanography, archaeology, security, and marine biology study and observation. Prevention of coral bleaching and degradation is vital for reducing coral mortality, as climate change and increased water pollution put coral reefs in threat. As a result, precise and effective methods for enhancing underwater images and identifying coral health must be created. This project aims to assess three techniques to identify the most accurate underwater image enhancing method: Underwater Image Enhancement Using White Balance, USM, and CLHE; Natural-based Underwater Image Color Enhancement through Fusion of a Swarm-Intelligence Algorithm; and Underwater Image Restoration and Enhancement Based on a Fusion Algorithm with Color Correction, Contrast Optimization, and Histogram Stretching. Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR), Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM), and Underwater Image Quality Measure (UIQM) are utilized to compare these methods. The selected method was used to enhance coral images for a model detecting coral health as healthy, bleached, or dead. Following the evaluation of all three approaches, NUCE obtained the highest UIQM score, while having lower PSNR and SSIM scores than the other methods. Consequently, this method was included in the YOLOv8m model for coral health classification, and it showed the highest confidence score to assess the coral's health state.

articleTitle: A review of security infrastructure, protocols, a taxonomy of security threats and intrusion detection in the Internet of Vehicles (IoV)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: The Internet of Vehicles (IoV) refers to an interconnected network where vehicles communicate with each other "Vehicle-to-Vehicle V2V", with infrastructure "Vehicle-to-Infrastructure (V2I)", with pedestrians "Vehicle-to-Pedestrian (V2P)", and with other entities through cloud services "Vehicle-to-Cloud (V2C)". While IoV offers numerous benefits like enhanced safety, traffic management, and user experience, it also presents significant security challenges due to its complexity, distributed nature, and critical real-time operations. The technological revolution of our age impacts all industries. It helps to move the more connected, and intelligent devices keep growing. Cities are also becoming more innovative and connected. It allows connected vehicles to be autonomous ones. On the other hand, cyber security issues are involved in these connected and intelligent transport systems (ITS) because unauthorized persons should refrain from tampering with or compromising the device’s authentic information. This paper elaborates on the issues involved in the Internet of Vehicles (IoV) blockchain solutions for security protocols, infrastructure, threat models, and security services. A detailed review of current security practices, evaluation techniques, and many challenges for the Internet of vehicular communications is presented.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Clustering Techniques for Segmenting IFS-Generated Garment Patterns
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: In the field of garment pattern creation, this work presents a contemporary implementation of Affine Iterated Function Systems (IFS). We use both K-means clustering and self-organizing map (SOM) to segment the visually appealing and complex patterns produced by IFS into discrete styles. These fractal patterns offer a break from traditional design techniques and are used as creative design templates for modern garment creation. Our research provides a cross-border new way of thinking in pattern design and prepares designers with new ways of seeking for originality, as it is an intersection of mathematical formulation and creative production. Box counting yields the fractal dimension of the created garment pattern, which is 1.477. This value indicates a balanced complexity appropriate for garment design. The resulting garments, inspired by fractal geometry, not only change aesthetic standards but also highlight the potential for sustainable and innovative practices in fashion.

articleTitle: Role of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to Enhancing Cloud Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: Organisations now have the ability to store, analyse, and manage their data more efficiently and flexibly thanks to cloud computing. Meanwhile, it's not easy to maintain robust cloud security when cyber threats are constantly evolving. This chapter explores the main functions of AI and ML to help you better understand their contributions to cloud security. The use of AI and ML allows organisations to strengthen their cloud infrastructure by detecting, mitigating, and responding to new cyber threats as they emerge. Security systems can now identify trends, outliers, and possible dangers in massive datasets with the help of AI-driven methodologies. Machine learning algorithms have the ability to learn from attack data that has already occurred, which allows for the identification of potential dangers and the creation of better defences. Further, identity management is strengthened by AI-enhanced authentication and access control systems, which lessen the likelihood of data breaches and unauthorised access.

articleTitle: Harnessing Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning for Precise Stock Price Forecasts
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: Stock market prediction has remained the subject of inquiry for a long time. Research intensified and new avenues were offered by the advent of computers and machine learning. By using easily accessible historical pricing and sentiment data, this research effort seeks to forecast stock share movements. The models were utilized: the GRU LSTM model that utilized past prices as its independent variable, and a Random Forest model that integrated sentiment analysis data obtained from Intensity Analyzer with other significant variables like the price of gold and oil, currency exchange rates, and policies of the Indian government. Securities returns were added for accuracy purposes. Predictions on the values of HDFC Bank, TCS, SBI-main, and four other shares were the final result. The models' effectiveness was evaluated using the RMSE metric.

articleTitle: Review on use of Immersive Technologies in Tourism
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: Nowadays immersive technologies play a very important role in different industries like automotive, manufacturing, marketing and advertising, travel, education, health care etc. Augmented Reality, Virtual Reality and Mixed Reality are the types of immersive technologies. Immersive technologies will have a very bright market soon. This paper firstly gives you a brief idea about immersive technologies. Immersive technologies have different use cases in different domains. Tourism is one of the important use cases of Immersive Technology. People can visit different historical places on their tour. Historical places have a tremendous amount of knowledge. By using immersive technologies, we can make visits to historical places more interesting and livable. So, people can enjoy their tour after visiting such places. Tourists will get proper guidance using these technologies. This paper also reviews previous research work that has been conducted for historical places outside India. This paper discusses different types of tracking techniques, devices and software used for immersive technologies and how to model a virtual environment.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approaches to Identify AI-Generated Text: a Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: Large-scale language models (LLMs), such as the GPT-4 from OpenAI and the Pathways Language Model from Google, have become indispensable to our daily lives and work, frequently being used without our conscious knowledge. Though study indicates that even crowdsourcing professionals have trouble identifying human-generated content from AI-generated content, subtle defects in AI writing continue to make this tough to perform. Even though these models have many benefits and the potential to totally change the way people work and learn, they have also drawn a lot of attention due to their potential drawbacks. One notable use of LLMs that demonstrates their potential for task automation is the generation of academic reports or articles with little to no human input. As a result, scientists have concentrated on creating detectors to deal with possible wrongdoing related to information provided by LLM. However, current methods frequently ignore the vital component of generalizability in favor of accuracy on small datasets. Our study offers a thorough examination of machine learning (ML) techniques that are intended to differentiate text produced by artificial intelligence (AI) from language created by humans. We attempt to use a Kaggle dataset in order to gain greater insight into the data collection procedure. To address the challenge of accurately and reliably detecting text produced by artificial intelligence (AI), we explore various machine learning approaches. We examine a broad spectrum of algorithms taking into account performance measures and their generalizability to different datasets and scenarios. By providing a more thorough explanation of the significance of LLMs, the challenges they provide, and the specific focus of our study, we broaden the abstract and lay the foundation for a thorough analysis of ML algorithms for text identification.

articleTitle: Machine Learning: Driven Strategies for Enhancing Student Academic Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: In order to improve learning outcomes and reduce dropouts, educational institutions must anticipate students' academic performance. This study focuses on identifying effective prediction models and employing a wrapper feature selection method to estimate students' performance in final examinations. Utilizing a well-established dataset from diverse engineering departments, comprising 3560 data samples, the research aims to select the optimal algorithm and feature selection technique for predicting the number of course arrears for each student. Regression predictive modeling, specifically for numerical value prediction, is employed along with relevant metrics to assess model performance. The study employs various machine learning approaches to forecast students' academic performance based on acquired data, including ongoing assessments and examinations. A comparative evaluation of ML techniques using different metrics is presented. This information empowers students to monitor their academic progress and adapt their study strategies for improved performance. Additionally, five feature selection strategies are applied to identify the most accurate predictor. The study incorporates regression algorithms and wrapper feature selection methods to enhance student performance outcomes. Experimental results highlight the effectiveness of the Variance Inflation Factor (VIF) with adaptive Decision Tree regression as the superior approach.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach for Detection of Anomalies in Surveillance Videos using ConvLSTM and Mask R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: In recent days automatic detection of anomalies from surveillance scenes have become major research. Though various deep learning algorithms are being developed, it is still difficult for many models to detect unusual activities in surveillance scenes. Anomalies like carrying weapons, fights, accidents and abandoning objects are rapidly increasing. To detect these anomalies and to overcome the challenges in automatic surveillance systems a novel methodology is proposed which offers a computationally effective and efficient way for video anomaly detection. Initially anomaly recognition is performed evaluating visual fidelity abnormalities for each video frame using signal PSNR ratio. Next, a hybrid model using ConvLSTM and MaskRCNN is combined to detect and classify the anomalies. The system can now dynamically focus on important areas of the movie thanks to this integration. This capability is superior to that of conventional analysis techniques. The system with two structures is more susceptible to different irregularities. Furthermore, the system has picture signals installed, which enhances the data feature more accurate extraction. After a comprehensive evaluation of the benchmark dataset, the suggested method has been proven to work better than the state of art methods. It performs exceptionally well in demanding monitoring situations. For instance, we were able to obtain an area under the curve (AUC) value of 87.96% in the PETS dataset, which surpasses the majority of modern techniques.

articleTitle: Smart Health Monitoring: The Application of IoT and AI For Real-time monitoring and patient centric care
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: The combination of artificial intelligence (AI) and the internet of things (IoT) resulted in the era of smart health monitoring. This article explores the seamless integration of IoT and AI technologies to provide real-time monitoring and patient-centered treatment in an evolving healthcare environment. Various real-time health data focuses from Internet of Things (IoT) gadgets, such as medical-grade screens and wearable sensors, offer new points of view on a person's physiological parameters and behaviors. These gadgets serve as the essential information collectors, quickly sending information to centralized stages. These systems' AI calculations filter approaching information at a speed and exactness never before achievable, permitting for the early discovery of patterns and irregularities. IoT and AI work together to extend the adequacy of information preparing and empower proactive, individualized healthcare interventions. Machine learning has the potential to anticipate potential health issues and give custom-made interventions by utilizing different datasets for model training. This approach advances a move from responsive to preventive healthcare practices. This approach is especially supportive within the administration of constant ailments since it can essentially make strides understanding results on the off chance that intervene early. With smart health monitoring, there are execution issues related to information security, ethics, and interoperability. The paper addresses these issues and offers potential arrangements to ensure the suitable integration of IoT and AI innovation in healthcare settings. With a center on values changing over time, this article offers a comprehensive analysis of worldly designs utilizing scatter plots. To imagine these worldly elements, we utilize a dataset that contains verifiable records of esteem changes for diverse factors and districts. Through investigation, we reveal designs, patterns, and peculiarities within the information that shed understanding on the basic reasons for these changes. The discoveries have centrality for different scholastic areas such as financial matters, horticulture, and natural thinks about, and give profitable experiences into the advancement of values. After that, scramble plots with personalized names, titles, and legends were made to appear how the values changed over time.

articleTitle: Integrating AI-Driven IoT Solutions for Enhanced Predictive Analytics in Healthcare a Comprehensive Study on Chronic Disease Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: The high incidence of chronic non-communicable diseases (NCDs) places a significant financial strain on public health systems. Brazil is projected to see a rise in mortality rates caused by non-communicable diseases (NCDs) by 2030. These include cancer, cardiovascular disease, respiratory illness, and diabetes. The unique challenge of managing chronic and integrated care for NCDs is well-documented. This study presents an AI-based framework for managing chronic diseases and providing digital health services globally. The suggested platform is constructed and supported by healthcare 4.0 technologies, which enable the implementation of a smart healthcare system. Among these innovations are AI-enabled cloud solutions, the internet of medical things, and wearable technology. Also included in the publication is a case study of diabetes prediction that demonstrates the platform's viability. An initial dataset was created for the research case with many attributes, including bio-impedance, skin impedance, skin temperature, pulse rate, and oxygen concentration. In this study, we investigate how the IoT and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are changing the face of illness detection in connected healthcare systems. AI has quickly become an indispensable tool in the healthcare industry, providing advanced algorithms for evaluating medical data and facilitating forecasting and decision-making. The internet of things (IoT) improves upon this by allowing web-enabled devices, such as implanted sensors and wearables, to continuously gather data. By integrating AI and IoT, smart healthcare systems improve medical procedures, patient experiences, and operational operations. Rapid and reliable disease diagnosis is made possible by combining AI-driven procedures with IoT data streams. This paper aims to overcome the limitations of traditional methods, which are typically influenced by human biases.

articleTitle: From Bytes to Biomes: Cyber Intelligence for Biodiversity Protection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: In recent years, cybersecurity intelligence has emerged as an essential tool not only for protecting digital assets but also for safeguarding the natural environment. As biodiversity faces unprecedented threats from climatic shifts, habitat destruction, and pollution, the implementation of cyber intelligence represents a novel frontier in the protection of natural ecosystems. This paper explores the synergy between cybersecurity and biodiversity protection, focusing on how cyber intelligence can aid in combating environmental crimes, monitoring endangered species, and enhancing conservation efforts. By integrating advanced cybersecurity protocols and intelligence into biodiversity management, and implementing key technologies such as drones, IoT devices, secure data collection, predictive analytics, and blockchain, can fortify conservation efforts. By examining case studies, this research highlights the transformative impact of advanced technologies on protecting nature and various species, thereby providing insights into future directions for integrating these fields to preserve our planet’s biodiversity.

articleTitle: Research developments, trends and challenges on the rise of machine learning for detection and classification of malware
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: These days, malware is a major issue for anybody who uses the internet. Malicious software has evolved into a new breed called polymorphic malware, which is far more versatile than earlier waves. Since polymorphic malware is constantly altering its signature to avoid detection, it is infamously tough to identify. Several different machine learning algorithms were used to identify malicious malware and other security risks. Due to its high detection ratio, the most accurate approach was selected for system utilisation. The confusion matrix provided more insight into the system's performance since it tracked the amount of false positives and false negatives. We found that malicious computer traffic may be discovered through our research into malware analysis and detection utilising machine learning approaches, which could lead to improved network security. Naive Byes, SVM, RF, and J48 were the four algorithms used. The data showed that DT (99%), CNN (98.76%), and SVM (96.41%) were the top three classifiers in terms of detection accuracy. On a dedicated dataset, we tested DT, CNN, and SVM for malware identification using a tiny FPR. The results for DT, CNN, and SVM were 2.01%, 3.97%, and 4.63%, respectively. These results are significant because malicious software is becoming more common and more complex.

articleTitle: Space Debris Clustering and Avoidance Using Chrono-Spatial Computational Frameworks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: This paper investigates the utilization of Spatio-Temporal data structures, their applications and how they can be implemented. This study also explores the temporal data management of spatial data that is dynamic in nature. Moreover, this integration of appropriate temporal aspects to the spatial data structures like Quad Tree is explored, thus the concept of Spatio-temporal data structures is developed. One of the primary takeaways from this paper is that it incorporates convex hull algorithm into the cluster management systems. This integration is exemplified in the context of spacecraft path optimization during orbital missions and the clustering of space debris in the atmosphere of the earth. The interaction will allow users to model rocket trajectories, so it would be possible to identify the optimum outputs.

articleTitle: The Future of Hr Marketing Ai-Driven Approaches to Talent Acquisition and Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: The advent of AI has been a game-changer, impacting every facet of our life in this age of unparalleled technological progress. Every industry has seen the ripple effects of AI's profound impact, and human resource management is no exception. Artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming increasingly important within the framework of people management strategies, which is explored in this chapter. Optimisation of talent acquisition, development, and retention strategies can be achieved with the use of insights enabled by data and automation made available by the ever-improving AI technology. This chapter explores the potential benefits and drawbacks of artificial intelligence (AI) in talent management, as well as the ethical challenges that arise from its utilisation. This thesis seeks to shed light on the revolutionary potential of artificial intelligence (AI) in HRM and its influence on organisational success by analysing current trends and future outcomes.

articleTitle: Enhancing Image Crispness: A Detailed System for Versatile Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: From space shots to health checkups, improving photos is crucial. Improving the clarity of the image is crucial here. Techniques such as adjusting contrast and balancing the histogram in space may improve clarity and sharpness by directly managing pixel data. Meanwhile, Fourier Transform-based enhancement analyzes and modifies frequency portions to make precise modifications. These methods are crucial for duties like reducing sound in aerial photos and emphasizing microscopic health images. This illustrates how simple they are to employ to improve varied image quality. Choosing between spatial or frequency-based methods in real-life relies on the picture’s unique properties and desired improvements. Using space-based techniques on pixel values may improve the clarity of minor patterns in a picture. Frequency-based methods provide a unique perspective of light wavelengths utilized to produce visuals. A solid balance between keeping critical sections clear and reducing unnecessary picture components is crucial. When improving photographs, this balance yields the greatest outcomes, demonstrating how these principles apply to real-life circumstances.

articleTitle: Modified AI-based learning Approach to Secure Data using Deep learning algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: Intelligent cyber security systems and policies of today rely on deep learning, a technology derived from artificial neural networks (ANNs). Cyber risk analytics that use artificial intelligence (AI) to boost business resilience and understand cyber security risk: pros and cons. Make use of deep learning tools like generative adversarial networks, deep belief networks, deep transfer learning, and deep reinforcement learning to intelligently combat cyber threats. There is also a set of tools that includes generic adversarial networks, auto-encoders, multilayer perceptrons, convolutional neural networks, recurrent neural networks (also known as long short-term memory), and so on. It is also possible to use these networks in ensembles or hybrid techniques. The goal of the backpropagation method is to convert inputs into outputs by making the most of the network weights. When training, a number of optimisation methods are employed, including Adam, Stochastic Gradient Descent, and Limited Memory BFGS. A wide range of cybersecurity issues could be addressed by these neural networks. Building reliable Internet of Things (IoT) systems, detecting harmful botnet traffic, analyzing malware, and conducting security threat analyses are all possible with MLP-based networks. Finding a computationally expensive solution to a complex security model may be difficult with MLP since the model is hyperparameter sensitive and needs adjustment of many different parameters, including the number of hidden layers, neurons, and iterations.

articleTitle: Exploring Textual Hate Speech Detection Methods and Datasets: A Comprehensive Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: Although so-called hate speech is very common in the media, it poses major problems in terms of detection and control, given the density of the content and the difficulty of interpretation and context. This paper makes a critical review of key research into hate speech detection, bringing in innovative methodologies and some valuable insights. Progress toward enhancing the accuracy of detection. It is best to use advanced neural network architectures to detect speech discrimination in communication networks. Furthermore, research on spreading extremist content on platforms like Twitter and the psychological effect of hate speech also underscores the well-rounded nature of the problem and that more inter- disciplinary approaches should be taken. This review stresses the importance of precision, awareness of context, and transparency of algorithms in hate speech detection frameworks. Through Using leading-edge technologies and interdisciplinary expertise, researchers are attempting to develop resilient systems that can efficiently fight hate speech without compromising free expression and societal harmony.

articleTitle: Impact of ICT on Wetland Ecotourism: Boosting Tourist Engagement and Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: Ecotourism and Information and Communication Technology (ICT) are intricately connected to improve tourist satisfaction by offering enhanced, seamless, and customised travel experiences while promoting responsible and sustainable tourism practices. To effectively manage ecotourism, it is necessary to include visitors’ preferences, experiences, culture, and knowledge. Hence, the research aims to understand the level of satisfaction among visitors about the usefulness and efficiency of the digitalisation of ecotourism websites of Mangalajodi in Odisha. The mean values, principal component, and cluster analysis have been calculated to comprehend the degree of satisfaction and engagement of the tourists. The results indicate a need for improving websites in terms of information, communication, functionality, and technology. Further, tourists prioritise trip planning and multi-language assistance while visiting a pristine nature reserve. Therefore, policymakers and stakeholders must improve and effectively use ICT tools for tourist satisfaction and the success of ecotourism initiatives.

articleTitle: Interpretability-Based Virtual Drift Detection and Adaptation Algorithm: A Case Study on Tetouan’s Energy Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: The feature impact in multilinear regression models can vary significantly with changes in learning environments. Identifying feature importance and building models with minimal possible features helps to streamline models and reduce costs. However, in many domains, the importance of features changes due to various factors, which can decrease model performance or render the model obsolete. This leads to the phenomenon known as concept drift.Proper monitoring of changes in feature importance can help mitigate it. Interpretability techniques can determine feature importance and help manage these shifts, especially in streaming data where virtual drifts are challenging to detect and address. The proactive approach we introduced here is to handle concept drift arising from frequent virtual drifts. Our method identifies the most suitable model for recent data, ensuring more accurate forecasting and minimizing the impact of concept drifts. This approach enhances model performance by continuously adapting to changes in feature importance, providing a robust solution for dynamic data environments.

articleTitle: Machine learning techniques analysis to Efficient resource provisioning for elastic cloud services
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: By automatically allocating resources in response to changes in service demand, automated resource provisioning solutions enable elastic services. In order to decrease power consumption without sacrificing quality of service or service level agreements, these standards must be followed by services with strict latency or reaction time QoS requirements, such as continuously streaming data, heavily used web servers, or real-time big data analytics. Cloud computing and virtualised data centres frequently employ auto-scaling technologies to incorporate elasticity. These automatically determine resource allocation based on the significance of specific indicators monitoring the performance of infrastructure and/or services. By combining machine learning methods from queueing theory and time series forecasting, this study introduces and assesses a new predictive auto-scaling mechanism. The goal of the new mechanism is to optimise service response time, service level agreement fulfilment, energy consumption, and infrastructure costs by properly predicting the processing load of a distributed server and estimating the amount of resources that should be deployed. The suggested model outperforms competing classical models in terms of resource allocation and forecasting accuracy, according to the results.

articleTitle: Unveiling Sentiment Dynamics: Emotion Detection in Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: The paper demonstrate the interesting task of detecting emotions within the scope of natural language processing. Since many people have resorted to social media applications such as Facebook, Instagram, and others to express their ideas and emotions, it has become inevitable to address the issue of emotion based classification and interpretation of a given text. Also, in contrast to sentiment where one would only assess if a certain text is positive or negative, emotional detection goes a step further where it focuses on certain aspect of emotions. For this purpose, the authors make use of a range of machine learning and natural language processing capabilities. However, as content on the internet keeps increasing, so is the trend in concern with emotion detection which goes beyond simple sentiment analysis. In this study, although emotions can be understood in different forms, such as through speech, facial expressions the main concern is only about the reading text emotional understanding. The paper highlights the progress from simplistic sentiment analysis to complex emotion detection, outlining challenges as well as recapping the progress made in the area in recent times. It looks into the processes used to classify emotions including their extensive categories and the commonsensical model. In the course of time, aided by the improvements in machine learning and deep learning emotions contained in a piece of writing can be identified and evaluated, further evolved from the traditional concepts of keywords and key phrases, to the more advanced approaches which are able to construct the emotions of human beings.

articleTitle: Leveraging Ai And Data Analytics For Enhanced Decision-Making In Modern Management Practices
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: The capabilities that artificial intelligence (AI) offers to revolutionise strategic decision-making are a significant reason for the profound importance that AI has in the everchanging environment of the business world. Artificial intelligence provides leaders with sophisticated tools that enable them to master difficult situations and effectively foresee future obstacles. Businesses can stay ahead of the competition in settings that are always changing by using AI to make their decision-making processes more accurate, efficient, and forward-looking. This technology not only makes things run more easily, but it also helps businesses change with the times and do well in any market. Without artificial intelligence, we can't look at data. It can find patterns, trends, and ideas that people might not see. AI can quickly and correctly look at data and give people helpful information and suggestions that can help them make better decisions.

articleTitle: Bridging Traditional and Modern AI Techniques for Breast Cancer Histopathology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: One of the biggest healthcare challenges facing the world today is breast cancer, which needs to be effectively controlled with accurate and novel detection techniques. A comparison of breast cancer cases is presented in this paper using histopathology image analysis, focusing on handcrafted features versus transfer learning using pre-trained networks for multi-class classification. Addressing the global shortage of trained pathologists, our research highlights the potential of automated systems to aid in accurate diagnoses. Using digital pathology and computational algorithms, we aim to detect finer details in histopathological images essential for diagnosis. In this work, we assess the effectiveness of pre-trained networks, including VGG16, VGG19, ResNet50, a n d DenseNet.DenseNet121 and ResNet50V2 achieved the highest accuracy of 95.16%, significantly outperforming traditional handcrafted feature methods. This represents a notable improvement, demonstrating the efficacy of transfer learning in enhancing classification accuracy. We emphasize the critical role of AI in enhancing diagnostic accuracy and addressing the global shortage of pathologists, paving the way for advancements in medical diagnostics. We highlight the vital role AI plays in improving diagnostic precision and mitigating the world pathologist shortage, which opens up new avenues for medical diagnostics research and development.

articleTitle: Efficient Large-Scale Data based on Cloud Framework using Critical Influences on Financial Landscape
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: The financial industry has also been profoundly affected by the introduction of cloud computing. This research study delves into the effects of cloud computing on the financial sector, specifically looking at the pros, cons, and consequences for banks and other financial organisations. Starting with an introduction to the concept, the article goes on to describe cloud computing and its key features, including self-service capabilities, quick flexibility, measurable service, resource pooling, and widespread network access. After that, it explores the ways cloud computing has been used in the financial sector, specifically IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS. We take a look at the ways cloud computing can increase accessibility, cooperation, scalability, and cost reduction in the financial sector. In addition, the study delves into the difficulties linked to financial industry cloud adoption. Among the main topics covered are privacy and security worries, compliance with regulations, data sovereignty, vendor lock-in, and the difficulties of integration. The article delves into methods and recommendations for reducing the impact of these threats, including as encryption, authentication procedures, compliance frameworks, and hybrid cloud architectures. Additionally, the effects of cloud computing on innovation, customer experience, data analytics, risk management, and financial operations are examined. In addition to discussing how professionals' skill sets will need to adapt to a cloud-enabled world, the study delves into how financial institutions' roles will change over time. In its last section, the article reviews the results and stresses how cloud computing could revolutionise the financial sector. It stresses the importance of banks and other financial institutions thoroughly weighing the pros and cons of cloud adoption, creating strong security measures, and adjusting their business strategies to take full advantage of cloud computing.

articleTitle: Advancing Predictive Modeling in Healthcare A Data Science Approach Utilizing AI-Driven Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is based on the premise that machines may learn from data collected from different sources to mimic human intellect in order to carry out tasks, identify patterns, or anticipate outcomes. Many areas of technology have made extensive use of AI and ML algorithms, including: autonomous vehicles, recommendation systems in e-commerce and social media, financial technology, question answering systems, and natural language processing. In a similar vein, AI is quietly revolutionising healthcare research. Half a century ago, there was a lot of interest in using a rule-based method for illness diagnosis and clinical decision assistance. When it comes to diagnosing diseases and developing individualized treatment programs, AI systems show remarkable accuracy in analyzing medical imagery. Streamlining operations using AI-powered solutions improves efficiency and the patient experience, while predictive analytics help find patients at high risk so they can get preventative treatments. By automating monotonous operations, particularly in the domains of surgery and rehabilitation, robots powered by artificial intelligence also improve healthcare delivery. Data quality, interpretability, bias, and regulatory frameworks are all important concerns that must be resolved before AI can be used responsibly. Ethical and successful AI integration into healthcare requires robust regulatory frameworks, education, safety validation, human-AI collaboration, and education.

articleTitle: Harmonizing Creativity and Technology: The Impact of Cloud Computing on the Music Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: The music industry has undergone a profound transformation in recent decades, driven by technological advancements. The advent of digital music, streaming services, and social media has significantly altered the way music is created, distributed, and consumed. In this context, cloud computing has emerged as a powerful force, reshaping the landscape of the industry. This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of the integration of cloud computing into the music industry and its subsequent impact. The authors examined how advancements in cloud technology are revolutionizing music production, consumption, and distribution, enabling the emergence of innovative business models. The scalability and flexibility offered by cloud computing have empowered small IT product manufacturers to rapidly launch their services and bring their business ideas to fruition. Consequently, the music industry has witnessed a substantial shift, recognizing cloud computing as a key driver of business model innovation. Furthermore, the convergence of cloud computing with mobility, social media, and big data has not only transformed daily life but has also revolutionized business practices within the music industry.

articleTitle: Recognizing Wild Animals from Camera Trap Images Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: Animal detection using deep learning leverages advanced machine learning to identify and classify animals in images or videos. This technology has significant implications for wildlife conservation, animal population monitoring, and automated surveillance systems. Deep learning models, especially Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), have shown great success in image classification tasks, including animal detection. These models can learn complex patterns and features from large datasets, enabling them to distinguish between species with high accuracy. This project presents an approach to animal detection, specifically focusing on buffalos, using CNNs. The VGG16 model, pre-trained on the ImageNet dataset, is the main tool used, showcasing the strength of transfer learning. The process starts with loading images, which are then preprocessed to match the VGG16 input size. Once formatted, the images are fed into the model for prediction, and the results are decoded to provide clear classification outcomes. This paper highlights the effectiveness of CNNs, particularly the VGG16 model, in animal detection tasks and emphasizes the potential of transfer learning. By using pre- trained models trained on diverse datasets, high accuracy can be achieved in image classification tasks, even when target categories differ from the original dataset.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Automated Aircraft Surface Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: Detecting surface defects on aircraft is very critical for ensuring reliability and safety. The complexity of examining aircraft surfaces, coupled with the demand for specialized knowledge, has seen a transformative shift with the advent of deep learning methods. This research provides an in-depth analysis centered on the utilization of Deep Learning (DL) techniques like CNN, YOLO, GAN, and others, in identifying defects on the surfaces of aircraft. Representing the first extensive examination of this emerging field, the review meticulously analyzes twenty-two primary studies, delving into methodological approaches and conceptual foundations. Encompassing major use cases, the study explores their significance in elevating defect detection for aircraft surfaces. Results from this thorough review underscore the potential of deep learning to significantly enhance the accuracy and effectiveness of visual inspection, particularly in identifying defects on aircraft surfaces. Additionally, the study provides a comprehensive compilation of use cases for computer vision and deep neural networks applications in the aviation industry, accompanied by an assessment of technology readiness level. The research brings out the crucial importance of exploring deep learning for detecting aircraft surface defects. These insights drive the aviation industry towards adopting safer and more efficient inspection practices.

articleTitle: Enhancing Customer Churn Prediction: Advanced Models and Resampling Techniques in Dynamic Business Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Emerging Communication Technologies (ICEC)
abstract: Customer churn analysis is critical for businesses looking to hold onto market share in today’s dynamic business environment. The development of e-Finance presents additional difficulties for the traditional banking sector as the digital marketplace grows. Banks face several challenges, including fintech competition, dwindling client loyalty, and digital transformation. Bank managers can identify problems, identify potential churn customers early on, and develop effective retention strategies based on client traits and preferences by analyzing probable causes of bank customer turnover from multiple perspectives and building models for predicting churn. Not only banks but also large corporate sectors like telecommunication, and over-the-top (OTT) platforms do face customer churn.
